```python
# Per-layer loop 核心逻辑：
for layer_idx in range(num_layers):
    dense_act = intermediates[layer_idx]    # [B, S, intermediate_size], detached from frozen model
    inp = layer_inputs[layer_idx]           # [B, S, hidden_size]
    
    pred_logits = wrapper.predictors[layer_idx](inp)
    
    # Gumbel-Sigmoid differentiable mask (与 KL 训练一致)
    soft_mask = torch.sigmoid(pred_logits / tau)
    hard_mask = (pred_logits > 0).float()
    diff_mask = hard_mask - soft_mask.detach() + soft_mask  # STE
    
    down_proj = wrapper.model.model.layers[layer_idx].mlp.down_proj
    with torch.no_grad():
        dense_out = down_proj(dense_act)    # target
    sparse_out = down_proj(dense_act.detach() * diff_mask)  # grad through mask
    
    total_mse += F.mse_loss(sparse_out, dense_out)

# 加 sparsity regularizer (与 KL/BCE 相同的 adaptive penalty)
```
